expansion_training.note: 8 scenarios/round; rounds 1-10 use 20000-20079; PRESERVED as the training expansion bank for all new training runs

codex_m100_final.role: historical; also reused here ONLY as the pre-registered baseline-reproduction bank (section 1 of the task), never for tuning or selection of the new recipe

local_diagnosis.role: Stage A hard-episode mining and before/after single-update local checks (gathering-side); plus round-1 expansion episodes 20000-20007 which are training data

anchor_raw.role: Stage A anchor bank: small fixed raw bank to detect global regressions caused by local repairs; never used for final selection

qualification_raw.role: Stage B short-qualification fixed raw screening bank; candidate recipes are compared ONLY on this bank's raw policy metrics

m50_checkpoint_selection.role: Stage D per-round fixed raw M50 CRN bank for the frozen final recipe; checkpoint selection uses ONLY this bank via the predeclared SELECTION_RULE.json

m100_final_confirmation.role: Stage E disjoint confirmation of r0 vs selected expanded checkpoint vs locked Kazuki; never read before the checkpoint is frozen

iteration2_m50_selection.role: iteration-2 M50 checkpoint selection (see ITERATION2_PREREGISTRATION.json); declared because the iteration-1 selection bank (320000) was read for two declared diagnostic companion cells (B9 r1/r2) and is therefore retired for selection purposes

disjointness_note: All new ep0 ranges (300000-330099) are disjoint from every historical bank listed in sfm_protocol.py (12000, 20000+, 50000, 80000, 90000, 110000, 130000, 150000, 170000, 190000, 210000, 230000, 250000) and from the codex funnel banks (260000, 270000, 280000). Noise seeds 20260726-20260730 are new.
rule: No episode or noise bank used to choose hyperparameters appears in final confirmation.
